data.description:
Found by the evidence pass on ticket sole-curbable-stinkpot (9a71-ba9b-89d0-4cb8), which showed these runs were MISATTRIBUTED to ACLI 'command cancelled'.

Two failed Reconcile Bridge runs converged the reconcile successfully and then died in git delivery to origin/tickets with a TLS trust failure:

- run 31535962079 (2026-08-11T21:02Z): 'push-transport-failed: fatal: unable to access https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/: server certificate verification failed. CAfile: none CRLfile: none' -> 'Bridge delivery failed (exit 1)', 3 unpushed commits left behind.
- run 31420498173 (2026-08-10T18:43Z): reconcile CONVERGED, then the commit-and-push step: 'merge-recovery-blocked: fatal: ... server certificate verification failed. CAfile: none CRLfile: none' plus 'fatal: could not fetch 983800f2 from promisor remote', 2 unpushed commits.

'CAfile: none CRLfile: none' points at the runner's CA bundle not being resolved (http.sslCAInfo / ca-certificates on the hosted runner), not at a rebar bug per se — but the blast radius is rebar's: a converged pass whose events never reach origin/tickets is silently lost work, and the heartbeat canary is the only detector.

Worth checking whether the delivery step should retry a transport failure and whether unpushed commits are recoverable on the next pass or need manual recovery.
data.title: Reconcile Bridge git delivery fails on TLS 'server certificate verification failed'
